hl01.name: hierarchical_id_number
hl01.description: Hierarchical ID Number (X12 AN 1/12). 837P content: numeric characters only. Sequential continuing from parent within ST-SE.

hl04.name: hierarchical_child_code
hl04.description: 0=No Subordinate HL (subscriber is patient), 1=Additional Subordinate HL Exists (patient is dependent in 2000C)

sbr01.name: payer_responsibility_sequence_number_code
sbr01.description: P=Primary, S=Secondary, T=Tertiary, A-H=Payer Responsibility Four through Eleven, U=Unknown

sbr02.name: individual_relationship_code
sbr02.conditional: Required when the patient is the subscriber or is considered to be the subscriber. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

sbr03.name: subscriber_group_or_policy_number
sbr03.conditional: Required when the subscriber's identification card for the destination payer (Loop ID-2010BB) shows a group number. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send. This is not the number uniquely identifying the subscriber (that is Loop ID-2010BA NM109).
sbr03.description: Group or policy number from subscriber ID card

sbr04.name: subscriber_group_name
sbr04.conditional: Required when SBR03 is not used and the group name is available. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

sbr05.name: insurance_type_code
sbr05.conditional: Required when the destination payer (Loop ID-2010BB) is Medicare and Medicare is not the primary payer (SBR01 does not equal P). If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.
sbr05.description: 12=Medicare Secondary Working Aged, 13=ESRD, 14=No-fault, 15=Workers Comp, 16=PHS/Other Federal, 41=Black Lung, 42=VA, 43=Disabled Beneficiary Under Age 65, 47=Other Liability

sbr09.name: claim_filing_indicator_code
sbr09.conditional: Required prior to mandated use of the HIPAA National Plan ID. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.
sbr09.description: 11=Other Non-Fed, 12=PPO, 13=POS, 14=EPO, 15=Indemnity, 16=HMO Medicare Risk, 17=DMO, AM=Auto Medical, BL=BCBS, CH=CHAMPUS, CI=Commercial, DS=Disability, FI=FEP, HM=HMO, LM=Liability Med, MA=Medicare A, MB=Medicare B, MC=Medicaid, OF=Other Fed, TV=Title V, VA=VA, WC=Workers Comp, ZZ=Mutually Defined

PAT.name: Patient Information
PAT.conditional: Required when the patient is the subscriber or considered to be the subscriber and at least one of the element requirements are met. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

pat05.name: date_time_period_format_qualifier
pat05.conditional: Required when patient is known to be deceased and the date of death is available to the provider billing system. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.
pat05.description: D8=Date Expressed in Format CCYYMMDD; paired with PAT06 via syntax_rules P0506

pat06.name: patient_death_date
pat06.conditional: Required when patient is known to be deceased and the date of death is available to the provider billing system. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.
pat06.description: Patient death date; paired with PAT05 via syntax_rules P0506

pat07.name: unit_or_basis_for_measurement_code
pat07.conditional: Required when claims involve Medicare Durable Medical Equipment Regional Carriers Certificate of Medical Necessity (DMERC CMN) 02.03, 10.02, or DME MAC 10.03. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.
pat07.description: 01=Actual Pounds; paired with PAT08 via syntax_rules P0708

pat08.name: patient_weight
pat08.conditional: Required when claims involve Medicare Durable Medical Equipment Regional Carriers Certificate of Medical Necessity (DMERC CMN) 02.03, 10.02, or DME MAC 10.03. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.
pat08.description: Patient weight in pounds; paired with PAT07 via syntax_rules P0708

pat09.name: pregnancy_indicator
pat09.conditional: Required when mandated by law. The determination of pregnancy shall be completed in compliance with applicable law. Y indicates the patient is pregnant. If PAT09 is not used, the patient is not pregnant or the indicator is not mandated by law. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

validation_rules.rule: HL01 is X12 AN 1/12; 837P content must be numeric characters only; sequential within ST-SE
HL02 required and must reference parent 2000A HL01; HL03=22; HL04=0 (patient=subscriber, no 2000C) or 1 (dependent in 2000C)
SBR01 required (A-H/P/S/T/U); SBR02=18 situational when patient is/considered subscriber; otherwise do not send
SBR03 situational when group number on destination payer ID card; SBR04 situational when SBR03 not used and group name available
SBR05 situational Medicare secondary only when destination payer is Medicare and SBR01!=P; codes 12/13/14/15/16/41/42/43/47 only
SBR06-SBR08 not used; SBR09 situational prior to National Plan ID
PAT situational when patient is/considered subscriber and at least one element needed; PAT01-PAT04 not used; P0506/P0708
When patient is/considered subscriber, do not send 2000C/2010CA; claim floats under 2010BB

nm104.name: subscriber_first_name
nm104.conditional: Required when NM102=1 (person) and the person has a first name. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

nm105.name: subscriber_middle_name
nm105.conditional: Required when NM102=1 (person) and the middle name or initial of the person is needed to identify the individual. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.
nm105.description: Middle name or initial when NM102=1

nm107.name: subscriber_name_suffix
nm107.conditional: Required when NM102=1 (person) and the name suffix of the person is needed to identify the individual. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.
nm107.description: Name suffix when NM102=1 (examples: I, II, III, IV, Jr, Sr)

nm108.name: identification_code_qualifier
nm108.description: II=Standard Unique Health Identifier for Individuals, MI=Member Identification Number; paired with NM109 via syntax_rules P0809

nm109.name: subscriber_primary_identifier
nm109.description: Subscriber primary identifier; paired with NM108 via syntax_rules P0809

N3.name: Subscriber Address
N3.conditional: Required when the patient is the subscriber or is considered to be the subscriber. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

n302.name: subscriber_address_line_2
n302.conditional: Required when there is a second address line. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

N4.name: Subscriber City, State, ZIP Code
N4.conditional: Required when N3 is present. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

n402.name: subscriber_state_or_province_code
n402.conditional: Required when the address is in the United States of America, including its territories, or Canada. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

n403.name: subscriber_postal_zone_or_zip_code
n403.conditional: Required when the address is in the US/territories or Canada, or when a postal code exists for the country in N404. For US addresses, the full nine-digit ZIP code must be provided. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

n404.name: country_code
n404.conditional: Required when the address is outside the United States of America. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

n407.name: country_subdivision_code
n407.conditional: Required when the address is not in the US/territories or Canada, and the country in N404 has administrative subdivisions. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

DMG.name: Subscriber Demographic Information
DMG.conditional: Required when the patient is the subscriber or considered to be the subscriber. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

dmg01.name: date_time_period_format_qualifier
dmg01.description: D8=Date Expressed in Format CCYYMMDD; paired with DMG02 via syntax_rules P0102

dmg02.name: subscriber_birth_date
dmg02.description: Subscriber birth date; paired with DMG01 via syntax_rules P0102

REF_SY.name: Subscriber Secondary Identification
REF_SY.conditional: Required when an additional identification number to that provided in NM109 of this loop is necessary for the claim processor to identify the entity. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

ref02.name: subscriber_supplemental_identifier
ref02.description: Social Security Number: exactly 9 digits, no separators

REF_Y4.name: Property and Casualty Claim Number
REF_Y4.conditional: Required when the services included in this claim are to be considered as part of a property and casualty claim. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

ref02.name: property_casualty_claim_number
ref02.description: Property and casualty claim number from the P&C payer

PER.name: Property and Casualty Subscriber Contact Information
PER.conditional: Required for Property and Casualty claims when this information is deemed necessary by the submitter. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

per02.name: subscriber_contact_name
per02.conditional: Required when the Subscriber contact is a person other than the person identified in the Subscriber Name NM1 (Loop ID-2010BA). If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.
per02.description: Contact name when different from NM1

per03.name: communication_number_qualifier_1
per03.description: TE=Telephone; paired with PER04 via syntax_rules P0304

per04.name: communication_number_1
per04.description: Telephone number (NANP: AAABBBCCCC, no leading 1); paired with PER03 via syntax_rules P0304

per05.name: communication_number_qualifier_2
per05.conditional: Required when this information is deemed necessary by the submitter. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.
per05.description: EX=Telephone Extension; paired with PER06 via syntax_rules P0506

per06.name: communication_number_2
per06.conditional: Required when this information is deemed necessary by the submitter. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.
per06.description: Telephone extension (numeric only); paired with PER05 via syntax_rules P0506

per07.name: communication_number_qualifier_3
per07.conditional: Required when this information is deemed necessary by the submitter. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.
per07.description: Third qualifier; paired with PER08 via syntax_rules P0708

per08.name: communication_number_3
per08.conditional: Required when this information is deemed necessary by the submitter. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.
per08.description: Third number; paired with PER07 via syntax_rules P0708

validation_rules.rule: NM101=IL; NM102=1|2; NM103/NM108/NM109 required; NM108=II|MI only (not ZZ); P0809/C1110/C1203
NM104/NM105/NM107 situational when NM102=1; NM106 and NM110-NM112 not used
N3 situational when patient is/considered subscriber; N302 situational second line
N4 required when N3 present; E0207/C0605/C0704; N405-N406 not used; US ZIP nine digits per X222
DMG situational when patient is/considered subscriber; DMG01=D8, DMG02 CCYYMMDD, DMG03=F|M|U; DMG04-DMG11 not used; P0102
REF_SY situational max 1; REF01=SY; REF02 exactly 9 digits; R0203; REF03-REF04 not used
REF_Y4 situational P&C max 1; REF01=Y4; R0203; REF03-REF04 not used
PER situational P&C max 1; PER01=IC, PER03=TE, PER04 required; PER05=EX situational; P0304/P0506/P0708; PER09 not used

nm103.name: payer_name
nm103.description: Payer / insurance company / TPA / repricer name

nm108.name: identification_code_qualifier
nm108.description: PI=Payor Identification, XV=CMS Plan ID; paired with NM109 via syntax_rules P0809

nm109.name: payer_identifier
nm109.description: Payer primary identifier; paired with NM108 via syntax_rules P0809

N3.name: Payer Address
N3.conditional: Required when the payer address is deemed necessary by the submitter. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

n302.name: payer_address_line_2
n302.conditional: Required when there is a second address line. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

N4.name: Payer City, State, ZIP Code
N4.conditional: Required when N3 is present. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

n402.name: payer_state_or_province_code
n402.conditional: Required when the address is in the United States of America, including its territories, or Canada. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

n403.name: payer_postal_zone_or_zip_code
n403.conditional: Required when the address is in the US/territories or Canada, or when a postal code exists for the country in N404. For US addresses, the full nine-digit ZIP code must be provided. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

n404.name: country_code
n404.conditional: Required when the address is outside the United States of America. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

n407.name: country_subdivision_code
n407.conditional: Required when the address is not in the US/territories or Canada, and the country in N404 has administrative subdivisions. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

REF.name: Payer Secondary Identification
REF.conditional: Required prior to the mandated implementation date for the HIPAA National Plan Identifier when an additional identification number to that provided in the NM109 of this loop is necessary for the claim processor to identify the entity. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

ref01.name: reference_identification_qualifier
ref01.description: 2U=Payer Identification Number (only when National Plan ID in NM109), EI=Employer's Identification Number, FY=Claim Office Number, NF=NAIC Code

REF_G2.name: Billing Provider Secondary Identification
REF_G2.conditional: Required prior to the mandated NPI Implementation Date when an additional identification number is necessary for the receiver to identify the provider; OR on or after the mandated NPI Implementation Date when NM109 in Loop 2010AA is not used and an identification number other than the NPI is necessary. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

ref02.name: billing_provider_secondary_identifier
ref02.description: Legacy provider number assigned by payer

validation_rules.rule: NM101=PR, NM102=2, NM103/NM108/NM109 required; NM104-NM107 and NM110-NM112 not used; NM108=PI|XV; P0809/C1110/C1203
N3 situational; N302 situational second line
N4 required when N3 present; E0207/C0605/C0704; N405-N406 not used; US ZIP nine digits per X222
REF payer secondary situational max 3; REF01=2U|EI|FY|NF only (no G2); R0203; REF03-REF04 not used
REF_G2 billing provider secondary situational max 2; REF01=G2|LU; R0203; REF03-REF04 not used
